options.mcaddon.title: Bedrock Add-ons
options.mcaddon.colourGrading.tooltip: Lets add-ons grade the picture per biome, the way Bedrock Edition does under Vibrant Visuals. Off by default, as in Bedrock's default graphics.
options.mcaddon.paperDoll.tooltip: Draws your player small in the top left corner while you sneak, swim, fly, glide or ride, the way Bedrock Edition does.
mcaddon.server_trust.title: Server identity changed
mcaddon.server_trust.message: %s identifies itself with another key than the last time you joined. Accept the new identity to play, or disconnect.
mcaddon.server_trust.refused: You did not accept the server's new identity.
